items.title: Cost of Man Utd hiring and firing managers nears £100m

items.title: Kane set to miss three months with ankle injury
items.desc: Harry Kane is expected to be sidelined for three months after suffering an ankle injury during Bayern Munich's Bundesliga game with Cologne on Friday.

items.desc: Coventry boss Frank Lampard wants officials to spend time ensuring they get decisions correct in the wake of his side being denied a penalty at Everton.
